title: Yao Ming takes back his tribe
summary: Yao Xiaotian reaches the Nine Serene Spring and badly hurts Little Fairy Doctor and Qing Lin while Medusa holds him off. Xiao Yan returns and fights him alone, breaking the Yellow Spring Finger with the Great Heavenly Creation Palm and throwing off the Yellow Spring Grand Seal. The First Elder arrives, and Yao Xiaotian sends the guards away so he can silence everyone quietly. Then Yao Ming appears in front of the elders, and Elders Xian, Ming and Liu recognise him. He shows them the lost Nine Serene Profound Scepter and beats Yao Xiaotian himself, and Yao Xiaotian dies in a last attack. The First Elder leaves his body behind and flees with his demonic core inside an avatar.
events: Yao Xiaotian injures Little Fairy Doctor and Qing Lin; Medusa fights him.
Xiao Yan arrives and fights Yao Xiaotian, a mid-stage One-Star Dou Sheng.
Xiao Yan beats the Yellow Spring Finger and the Yellow Spring Grand Seal.
The First Elder arrives; Yao Xiaotian sends the Serene Python Guards away.
Yao Ming appears and Elders Xian, Ming and Liu side with him.
Yao Ming shows the Nine Serene Profound Scepter and the First Elder argues against him.
Yao Ming beats Yao Xiaotian, who dies hating his brother.
The First Elder escapes using Demonic Python Burst, hiding his core in an avatar.
